_comment: Chapter ladder: derive state.chapter from the banked story-flag store. chapter = the highest rung whose flag is set; default 1. Each rung's flag is a REAL decoded on_complete flag from story_steps.json events[].sets, with the gate event's identity confirmed by the esdmg cutscene text. The flag->chapter assignment (which leader = which chapter) is story-grounded (DW2003 4-team progression) and matches the chapter-advancement spec, which itself read these esdmg lines. See docs/research/scripting/chapter-progression-decode.md. NOTE (honest gap): the runtime mechanism that converts these flags into the NPC n-field comparand is not yet disasm-proven (the FIELDSTG spawn-instantiation loop was not located); this ladder is faithful to the confirmed STORY ORDER, which is what the walker needs.

ladder.evidence: story_steps s675 evt 410 (flag_key 01430000) sets 0x401e; esdmg600/0 'Byakko Leader: Welcome, challenger. Let's battle.' / esdmg600/1 'You are strong. I like you.'
story_steps s520 evt 260 (flag_key 013c0001) sets 0x4002; esdmg500/1 'Suzaku Leader: So, what, are you ready to step into my arena?'
story_steps s420 evt 70 (flag_key 01350002) sets 0x4012; esdmg400/2 player 'Seiryu Leader, I defeated MasterTyranno' -> esdmg400/3 'Seiryu Leader: You're pretty good. What is your name?'
story_steps s212 evt 271 (flag_key 01120018) sets 0x4004 and 0x4005; esdmg200/24 'Tamer Service: I will download the Digimon data'

frontier.note: ch2 is diffuse/minor (4 NPCs: a Digimon in Asuka s295, the same Digimon repeated in Byakko s620/621/625). No clean single gate flag identified. Until grounded, the ladder skips ch2: n=2 content first renders at chapter 3 (3 >= 2), i.e. one beat late. Acceptable approximation, documented.
